enable_detector: enable the GenericDetector by calling enable_detector to set is_enabled to True
disable_detector: disable the GenericDetector by calling disable_detector to set is_enabled to False
process_frame: process a DataFrame frame with a subclass of GenericDetector to get detections and metadata
create_subclass: create a subclass of GenericDetector that implements process_frame for custom detection logic
review_GenericDetector: review the GenericDetector class and its abstract process_frame interface for detector implementations
